risks.event_narrative: Third-party payment gateway API rate limiting causes transaction processing delays during peak periods.
risks.root_cause: Legacy API gateway lacks token bucket autoscaling configuration.
risks.trigger_symptoms: HTTP 429 response rate exceeds 1% of total transaction requests.
risks.action_plan: Implement Redis-backed local request caching and negotiate dedicated gateway burst tier.
